sections.heading: Learning to drive: second part — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: learning to drive: second part within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Lane changes and highway access; Passing; Railroad crossings; School buses; Parking. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Lane changes, freeway entry and exit, passing, railroad duties, school-bus rules and passenger-car parking are represented. Commercial vehicle railroad-stop procedures and small-device sidewalk-parking permissions are outside passenger-car scope. The final mapped page has no extractable content. Hill-parking wheel direction is source-qualified and awaits review rather than being silently replaced with outside knowledge.

sections.heading: Learning to drive: second part — C
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec06-F01 | anchor: A40
Blind spots are nearby areas that the interior and outside rear-view mirrors do not show. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F02 | anchor: A40
Before changing lanes, check the mirrors and turn your head over the shoulder toward the intended lane to check blind spots. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F03 | anchor: A40
Find a traffic gap, signal and look again toward the lane you intend to enter. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F04 | anchor: A40
Adjust speed and steering as you enter the new lane, then cancel the signal. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F05 | anchor: A40
On a freeway entrance, watch the vehicle ahead and use an over-shoulder check and outside mirrors to locate a merging gap. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F06 | anchor: A40
Signal and accelerate in the entrance lane to the speed of freeway traffic before merging, then cancel the signal. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F07 | anchor: A40
Know the intended exit and move toward its lane early enough to avoid a sudden lane change. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F08 | anchor: A40
Maintain speed on the main roadway, signal into the deceleration lane, and slow there while observing its posted speed. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F09 | anchor: A40
If you miss an exit, continue to the next one instead of using a median opening reserved for emergency and public-safety vehicles. [A40]
Source: [A40 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec06-F10 | anchor: A41
Before passing, check for approaching vehicles and use mirrors and an over-shoulder look to check vehicles following or already passing. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F11 | anchor: A41
When a pass is safe, signal and move smoothly into the passing lane while adjusting speed as needed. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F12 | anchor: A41
Continue a pass until both headlights of the passed vehicle appear in the rear-view mirror, then signal and return smoothly while maintaining an appropriate speed. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F13 | anchor: A41
When another driver passes, hold your lane and keep a steady speed so the pass can be completed. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F14 | anchor: A41
Do not start a pass when a vehicle is approaching from the opposite direction. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F15 | anchor: A41
Do not pass when a curve or hill blocks the view ahead. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F16 | anchor: A41
Do not attempt to pass at an intersection. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F17 | anchor: A41
Do not attempt a pass before a railroad crossing or bridge. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F18 | anchor: A41
On a multilane two-way road, the far-left lane is intended for passing slower vehicles when the pass will not interfere with traffic in either direction. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F19 | anchor: A41
Never use a roadway shoulder to pass, whether the shoulder is paved or unpaved. [A41]
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec06-F20 | anchor: A42
On a two-lane two-way road with double solid yellow centerlines, passing is prohibited except for a safe pass of a slow-moving vehicle such as a bicycle or a vehicle with a slow-moving-vehicle sign. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec06-F21 | anchor: A42
A driver may cross double solid yellow centerlines to turn left into a driveway when it is safe. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec06-F22 | anchor: A42
On a two-lane two-way road with a solid-and-dashed yellow centerline, passing is allowed only from the dashed-line side and is prohibited from the solid-line side. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec06-F23 | anchor: A42
A shared center left-turn lane serves left turns from either direction and must not be used for passing, merging into traffic or through travel. [A42]
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec06-F24 | anchor: A43
Railroad crossings may be identified by a round yellow sign bearing a cross and the letters R R, or by a white crossbuck labeled Railroad Crossing. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F25 | anchor: A43
Some railroad crossings have train-activated flashing red lights and may also have a gate. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F26 | anchor: A43
At a railroad warning sign, slow down and prepare to stop if you see or hear an approaching train. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F27 | anchor: A43
For an approaching train, stop between fifteen and fifty feet from the crossing. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

sections.heading: Learning to drive: second part — C2
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A43
Wait for the train to pass and for warning signals to stop before crossing the rails. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A43
Where only pavement markings or crossbucks mark a crossing, approach slowly and be ready to stop for a train seen or heard. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A43
Do not stop a vehicle on railroad tracks or try to cross ahead of an approaching train. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A43
Every vehicle must stop before proceeding through a railroad crossing marked by a stop sign. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A44
Four flashing amber bus lights, two at each end, warn that the bus is preparing to stop; drivers need not stop for amber alone but should prepare for the bus to stop. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A44
When a school bus stops to load or unload children, its amber lights change to four flashing red lights, with two at each end. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A44
A school bus may extend a flashing stop arm from its left side, but the absence of that arm does not remove the stopping requirement. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A44
On a road with fewer than four lanes, traffic approaching a stopped school bus from either direction must stop at least ten feet from it until the bus moves or its driver signals permission to proceed. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A44
On a road with at least four lanes, only traffic going the bus's direction must stop behind a stopped school bus and wait until the bus moves. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A44
A bus driver who believes a vehicle passed unlawfully may report its plate and location to law enforcement for driver identification. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A45
Use a designated parking area and face the direction of traffic on your side of the street. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A45
Park parallel within twelve inches of the right curb. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R13 | anchor: A45
On a one-way street, parallel parking is allowed within twelve inches of either curb. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R14 | anchor: A45
Painted lines mark spaces intended for angled parking. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R15 | anchor: A45
Check signs and painted curbs for parking prohibitions or limits. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R16 | anchor: A45
Do not use a wheelchair-marked accessible parking space without an issued removable windshield placard or accessible license plate. [A45]
Source: [A45 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-R17 | anchor: A46
Do not stop, park or stand a motor vehicle on a sidewalk unless needed to avoid a traffic conflict or to follow police or traffic-control directions. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R18 | anchor: A46
Do not stop, park or stand in front of a public or private driveway unless avoiding a traffic conflict or following police or traffic-control directions requires it. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R19 | anchor: A46
Except when avoiding a traffic conflict or obeying police or traffic-control directions, do not stop, park or stand in an intersection or crosswalk or within twenty feet of either. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R20 | anchor: A46
Do not stop, park or stand within ten feet of a fire hydrant unless needed to avoid a traffic conflict or to comply with police or traffic-control directions. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R21 | anchor: A46
Keep at least one foot from another parked vehicle when stopping, parking or standing, except as needed to avoid traffic conflict or obey police or traffic-control directions. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R22 | anchor: A46
Do not stop, park or stand beside a vehicle already stopped or parked along the street edge or curb, except for traffic-conflict avoidance or police or traffic-control directions. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R23 | anchor: A46
Do not stop, park or stand where a sign prohibits stopping unless avoiding a traffic conflict or obeying police or traffic-control directions requires it. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R24 | anchor: A46
For hill parking, the handbook directs turning the front wheels toward the curb side, selecting park, setting the parking brake and switching off the engine. [A46]
Source: [A46 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0046]

Confusables: accelerate before a freeway merge and decelerate after leaving the main roadway. A shared center turn lane is not a merge lane. Amber bus lamps warn of an upcoming stop; red lamps accompany loading or unloading. Mnemonic: gap, signal, look, move. Glossary: a blind spot is outside mirror coverage; a crossbuck marks a railroad crossing. These cues restate the accepted facts only.
